## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `10f2b24bfd08460bb1237e0cd57f11ffd446e2af`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md + none

Inputs read: card #33560 body and its four comments (triage 6886839461, scope add 6888544144, claim 6890844730, os-dev-report 6891036053); PR #33720 body, file list (8 files) and the net diff against merge-base `6ff3eee7` (+30 / -20); the check-runs on the head. The remainder of the diff is one changeset, the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Check-runs on the head at review time: 15 success, 16 skipped, 0 failed, 10 still in progress (Build Core, Test Core 1/8 and 2/8, Type Check workspace / consumer gates / debt ledger, Lint ESLint / docs and code guards / CI, release and engine gates / repo and tooling gates). Completed and green: Check Changeset, Lint PM dispatch-gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate, the three scoped Lint jobs, Test UI. This PASS is a design verdict; the gate verdicts of the ten running jobs are not yet answered and the seat reads them before merge.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged. No schema, validator, gate or runtime file is in the diff; every hunk is skill prose, an `os:check` example or an eval JSON. Right.
- Public surface: `@objectstack/skills` published text only. Nine example sites move from `assigned_to` / `assignee` to `owner_id`; one column (`{ field: 'assigned_to', label: 'Owner' }`) loses its colliding label; one comment gains a cross-reference. Right.
- Eval assertions tightened: ui evals 1 and 12 gain `owner_id` in `must_contain` and `'assigned_to'` (quoted) in `must_not_contain`; query eval 4 gains `owner_id` in `must_contain`. Each new literal occurs in its own `expected_output` and no forbidden literal does (read on the head). Right.
- ui eval 2 (scope add 6888544144): the assertion side is the correct one. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` lines 36 to 39 teach the inbox gated by `requiresService: 'approvals'` and say why not `requiresObject`; the reference prose now avoids the forbidden literal. Right.
- Surface breach, query eval 4 (outside the order's file list): owed. The card's "What lands" says "Evals updated to match"; the prompt asks for the task's assignee, which `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:313` maps to `owner_id`; left as it was, the eval would expect an `assignee` field that the query SKILL.md example in this same PR no longer teaches. Declared in the dev report and the PR body. Right.
- Gantt `columns` at list-views.md 321 (not cited by the card, same file, same pattern): right, and declared.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

`.changeset/33560-skills-owner-id-not-assigned-to.md` is `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, which matches what the diff publishes: corrected example text and evals, no accept-set change, nothing narrowed. The changeset and PR body both carry bare `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. Check Changeset is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1 (query eval 4 outside the named surface): accepted, see ①.
- Dev deviation 2 (gantt columns): accepted, see ①.
- Dev deviation 3 (thread ran on the default tier): answered by this at-tier record.
- Dev deviation 4 (seat-signed HTML comment in the PR body): PR-body guards check-run is green; not a contract matter.
- `open_questions`: empty. `security_findings`: none.
- Tier S vs Tier H: no security label is owed. The diff teaches no access rule. The one security-relevant sentence (a handler field grants no access; owner-scoped visibility reads `owner_id`) lives in objectstack-data on `main` and is cross-referenced, not restated. Each edit moves an example ONTO the column the access model already reads; none adds a field that grants or appears to grant access. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:216` (a `{current_user_id}` filter is never the access gate) is untouched. The low-risk arm reading stands.

### ④ Design judgment

Tried against `main`, the cited code read at the head:

- Does `owner_id` exist with the Owner label on the objects the examples use? Yes. `OWNER_FIELD_DEF` (`packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts`) is `{ type: 'lookup', reference: 'sys_user', label: 'Owner', readonly: false, system: true }`, injected by `applySystemFields` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `if (wantOwner && !schema.fields?.owner_id)`) under `ownership: 'user'` and when `ownership` is omitted. `support_case`, `task`, `project_task` and `lead` in the examples declare no other ownership tier. The zh-CN label 负责人 is the served translation the duplicate-label lint (`packages/lint/src/lint-duplicate-field-labels.ts`) already names.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`: holds. `{ field: 'owner_id' }` with no label inherits Owner, so the second-Owner-label shape of #33506 is gone. The "mine" rule `{ field: 'owner_id', operator: 'equals', value: '{current_user_id}' }` is character for character the form the spec's own conversion fixtures use (`packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array.ts`, `object-grid-default-filters-removed.ts`). The cross-reference target exists: `### Relationship Patterns` at `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:302`, the Record owner row at 313. It is the one cross-reference, and the rule is not restated. The dropped `{current_user_id}` gloss has its home at `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:205`.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`: holds. `params: [{ field: 'owner_id', required: true }]` on Reassign Lead: `owner_id` is not `readonly`, so a field-backed param inherits a writable user lookup, and reassignment is the by-id `owner_id` update the data skill describes (`allowTransfer` / `modifyAllRecords`). The lint's field resolution counts injected columns (`packages/lint/src/system-fields.ts`), so the reference is not a false finding.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`: holds. The record-shaped `filter: { owner_id: '{current_user_id}', ... }` is the spelling of `packages/spec/src/data/context-tokens.zod.ts:27` and of `rules/navigation.md:27`.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`: holds. `recipients: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.owner_id' }` yields one user id, the first accepted form; node id `tell_owner` and label "Notify Owner" now agree with the expression. Byte count unchanged against a ceiling with zero headroom.
- `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md`: holds. `fields` keeps the FK and `expand` keys on it, the spelling of the spec's own prescription (`packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts:392` and `:433`).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` evals 1, 2, 12 and `skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` eval 4: each prompt word (owner; the signed-in user's tasks; assignee) is answered the way the skills on this head teach, and nothing the skills teach is contradicted by an eval. Eval 1 no longer names a `support_case.assigned_to` the data template does not declare. No remaining `assigned_to` / `assignee` under `skills/**` means the owner: the survivors are the data rule itself (313, 441), `examples-objects.md:88`, `objectui/rules/protocol.md:300` (a param named `assignee` mapped to `owner_id`) and `must_not_contain` lists.
- No handler field is kept anywhere in the diff, so no "grants no access" sentence was owed.

Findings:

- nit — `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md:292` and query eval 4 write `owner_id: { object: 'user', ... }`, while the injected `owner_id` references `sys_user`. No effect on correctness: `expandRelatedRecords` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts`) never reads the nested `object`; it resolves the target through `referenceTargetOf(fieldDef)`, and `name` / `email` exist on the user object. It is also the spec's own prescribed spelling (`query.zod.ts:392`). Before this PR the key was a hypothetical `assignee`, so the mismatch was invisible; now it sits beside a field whose target is known. Accepted deviation, or a follow-up card that settles the spelling in the spec message and the skill together.
- nit, outside the diff, follow-up card only — `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:304` still filters `task` on `{ owner: uid }`, a hand-named owner field of the same family the card retires. Not on the card's list and not in this PR.

No must-fix, no should-fix. Nits alone end the round.
